title: ‘I’m single, too,’ ex-CJ Panganiban tells Hontiveros in jest

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Retired Chief Justice Artemio Panganiban injected some humor into Wednesday’s proceedings of the Senate Impeachment Court when he jokingly told Senator-judge Risa Hontiveros that he is still single.
